name: [CLASSIC] Untitled Fling Game
desc:
🗣️ Welcome to Untitled Fling Game! 

The game is under active development, we will be glad to have your help! 👀

How to Play:
🤯 Jump in and FLING EVERYTHING 
🧱 Grab items 
📦 Spawn stuff 
💥 Fling yourself and other players 
😄 Mess around and hang out with friends 

👍 LIKE THE GAME

🤝 | If you find a bug or have an idea for a game, please write to #forum
🔗 | Join our communications server for updates!

Inspired by Mori 'Fling Things and People'
